annotations.title: Get a job, or list jobs

description: Returns a job by job_id or idempotency_key: state, charge, and when succeeded each artifact once (path, bytes, sha256), one signed download base, a zip URL, warnings, compact QA, and preview_url. Waits up to wait_ms. Build a file URL as {download.base}{path}?{download.token}. detail=full returns the large report and a signed URL per file. detail=status returns state and charge only. Without job_id or idempotency_key, returns a page of recent jobs, which can be filtered by spec_name or state.

batch.description: Batch job_id. When set, list that batch's child jobs instead of recent jobs.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list's next_cursor. Pass it to read the next page.

detail.description: compact (the default, also called files): state, charge and each artifact once, plus one signed download base and a zip URL. lean is the same with less QA. full is the large report and a signed URL per file. status is per-job or per-variant state and charge only.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency_key of the job to return.

include_preview.description: Include a framed inspect still. Default true only for detail=full; compact and lean return the preview path on the download base instead.

limit.description: Page size when listing jobs. Defaults to 20. Minimum 1, maximum 100.

spec_name.description: When listing jobs, keep rows whose spec name matches.

wait_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the job to finish, up to 35 seconds.

name: get_job
title: Get a job, or list jobs
